proposal.explanation: Ranked by direct overlap with observed port failures: busy (cycle 13), s_axis_cmd_ready (cycle 13), sda_o/t (cycle 14/15), scl_o (cycle 26406). The top patches target rhs_substitution in regions driving start/stop timing, bus_active assertion, SCL/SDA drive, and PHY state release logic. The condition_gate patch (896da21b3566) qualifies the command valid check that gates all sequences. The state_retention patch (f249dd8b9502) preserves s_axis_data_tready across cycles to avoid premature deassertion. Lower candidates address narrower substitutions or lines distant from mismatch cycles.
